```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
library(jsonlite)

# Fetch the data
life <- read.csv("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy.csv?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true")
View(life)

# Fetch the metadata
life_metadata <- fromJSON("https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy.metadata.json?v=1&csvType=full&useColumnShortNames=true")
View(life_metadata)
```

```{r}
region <- life %>% 
  filter(code %in% c("OWID_AFR", "OWID_ASI", "OWID_OCE", "OWID_EUR") | 
           entity == "Americas")

region <- region %>%
  mutate(region_name = case_when(code == "OWID_AFR" ~ "Africa", code == "OWID_ASI" ~ "Asia", code == "OWID_OCE" ~ "Oceania", code == "OWID_EUR" ~ "Europe", entity == "Americas" ~ "Americas",
    TRUE ~ entity))

View(region)
```


```{r}
end_labels <- region %>%
  group_by(region_name) %>%
  filter(year == max(year, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

region_colors <- c("Africa" = "#A650A6",
  "Asia" = "#168C86",
  "Americas" = "#D95F3B",
  "Europe" = "#4666A6",
  "Oceania" = "#A65D2E")

ggplot(region, aes(x = year, y = life_expectancy_0, color = region_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = end_labels,
    aes(label = region_name),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3.5,
    show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 80, by = 10),
    limits = c(0, 82),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, " years")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1770, 1800, 1850, 1900, 1950, 2000, 2023),
    limits = c(1770, 2035)) +
  labs(title = "Life expectancy",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Period life expectancy is the number of years the average person born by continent"),
    x = "Years",
    y = "Life Expectancy") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal()
```
